registers.label: Spare
lines: Happy are those who delight in the law of the Lord.
Blessed are those who trust in God.
They are like trees planted by streams of water.
Blessed are those who trust in God.
Blessed are you who are poor, who hunger, who weep.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Imagine a tree by a river — roots deep, leaves green even in the dry season, unafraid of heat.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
That is the life rooted in God; not anxious, not withered, but bearing fruit in its time.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
And the blessings come to the unlikely: the poor, the hungry, the grieving, the cast out.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
So sink your roots by the water; the world's scorekeeping is not the kingdom's.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord; they shall not fear!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A tree by the river, green even in drought.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
The blessings fall on the poor, the hungry, the grieving.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
Sink your roots by the water and do not fear.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord. Amen.
